name: Production House Suite
promise: Move creative work through resumable jobs to verified deliverables.
completion_criteria: One Groundwire episode completes through ProductionJob with current audit and QC behavior preserved.
Formatter jobs, outputs, captions, manifests, retries, and failures link to the same job record.
Writers Room hands off versioned story state without becoming a second production runtime.
Adjacent pipelines join only after two shared mechanics prove reduced complexity.

waves.objective: Fingerprint one Groundwire episode workflow and its QC/output stages into the ProductionJob contract.
waves.acceptance: Inputs, steps, gates, receipts, failures, outputs, and recovery are mapped before integration, against fingerprinted production-house, Groundwire, and formatter sources.
waves.runtime_followup: Fingerprint from real episode artifacts rather than a fixture script hash.

waves.objective: Model that episode slice as a ProductionJob advancing through a synthesis stage, against a fingerprinted formatter source.
waves.acceptance: The job advances from queued to completed with at least one content-addressed output, without parallel canonical state. The formatter repository is fingerprinted, not invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Invoke elevenlabs-screenplay-formatter on a real script slice and compare its output against this job for parity and failure recovery.

waves.objective: Model a Writers Room story-state handoff as a ProductionJob input, against a fingerprinted writers-room source.
waves.acceptance: The handoff carries a versioned, approved input into a queued job and stays traceable to its source. Writers Room is fingerprinted, not read.
waves.runtime_followup: Take the story state from the real Writers Room runtime through to a derived output with its job receipt.

waves.objective: Run a structurally distinct investigative documentary episode fixture through the generic ProductionJob engine.
waves.acceptance: The variant completes with its full output set using the unchanged generic engine. Fixture-driven; no external documentary runtime is involved.
waves.runtime_followup: Drive the multi-track and sound-design pipeline from a real documentary episode.

waves.objective: Map Writers Room collaborative story state transitions into a canonical ProductionJob event stream.
waves.acceptance: Multi-scene revisions with author provenance unify into a single completed job event stream. Revisions are fixtures; Writers Room is not read.
waves.runtime_followup: Map real Writers Room revision history, including final room signoff, from that runtime.
